baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain "in their hearts is sickness -> they hurry among them -> we fear that a turning calamity will strike us."
baseline_models.mechanism: An impaired inner center shortens deliberation and converts anticipated reversal into accelerated relational positioning. The feared outer turn and the unstable inner center reinforce one another: they seek security by moving early into the group imagined to survive the next turn.

activation_trace.role: The heart as the seat of understanding supplies the inner decision center whose condition governs the rush.
Weakening an affair and shortening movement makes the sickness function as impaired resolve rather than merely a medical label.
Speed contrary to slowness supplies the preemptive tempo of the attempted hedge.
The adverse circle or defeat supplies the anticipated reversal around which their positioning is organized.

changed_reading.before: They hurry into an affiliation because they prudently fear a future political setback.
changed_reading.after: Their haste is a symptom-producing hedge: inner disequilibrium makes a feared reversal govern present allegiance before any reversal occurs.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The verse separates "they say: we fear" from "what they concealed within themselves."
baseline_models.mechanism: Audible explanation and stored intention occupy different channels. The stated fear can be real without exhausting the motive; a concealed inner commitment remains available for later exposure, and regret attaches to that hidden store rather than only to a failed forecast.

activation_trace.role: Uttered speech supplies the public and inspectable rationale.
Concealment in the interior supplies a second channel that the spoken rationale does not disclose.
The inner domain of intention and discernment locates the concealed material as purposive inward content.
Regret over a missed or completed matter makes the concealed content the eventual object of retrospective judgment.

changed_reading.before: The sentence reports one motive, fear, followed by embarrassment when the prediction fails.
changed_reading.after: The sentence stages a split account: fear is what is said, while an unspoken allegiance or intention is what the resulting event makes regrettable.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The feared "circle" is answered by God bringing "the opening" or "a matter from with Him," after which they become regretful.
baseline_models.mechanism: Circular contingency keeps the hedge viable because outcomes can keep turning. An opening that also carries a judgment branch, or another divinely sourced matter, closes that optionality. The intervention does not merely improve one side's fortunes; it converts a reversible private strategy into an irreversible public condition.

activation_trace.role: Rotation and enclosure supply the repeatable orbit within which opportunistic positioning seems rational.
Resolving closure by judgment supplies a decisive reading of the opening that can terminate the orbit.
A matter, state, or affair keeps the alternative intervention broad while still making it a concrete change of conditions.
Nearness and presence mark the intervention's provenance as divine rather than as another move inside the human orbit.
Becoming a new state supplies the conversion from concealed strategy to settled consequence.

changed_reading.before: God may grant victory or send some other favorable event.
changed_reading.after: God may introduce adjudicative closure from outside the cycle, making a reversible hedge become a fixed and regrettable stance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier self-facilitation, deed, attempted covering, and exact becoming-regret sequence turns the focus verse's hidden interior into a possible action-producing chamber. Concealment is not the end of the process: an externally supplied disclosure or lesson changes the actor's state and makes the hidden path legible as regret.

activation_trace.role: Interior concealment anchors the revised model in the focus verse's stored motive.
The self making an act easy supplies a mechanism by which inward content can facilitate outward conduct.
The inner domain of intention identifies the facilitating self as a purposive interior rather than a passive container.
Putting something behind visibility supplies the attempted covering stage between deed and recognition.
The shameful part that is covered supplies the concealed object's morally exposing character.
Becoming a state exactly matches the focus verse's transition formula and supplies the temporal conversion.
Regret over what has passed exactly matches the focus endpoint and makes the earlier sequence a causal template.

structural_cues: 5:30-31 moves from an inward self making a deed easy, through attempted covering, to "he became one of the regretful."
5:31 and 5:52 share the paired transition "became/become" plus "regretful."
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the self-facilitation and concealment-to-regret sequence plus the exact endpoint recurrence; I infer that the focus secret may likewise be action-facilitating and later exposed. A live alternative is that the recurrence marks only a shared result, not a shared causal path.

changed_reading.before: Their secret is a private belief that becomes embarrassing after an unexpected outcome.
changed_reading.after: Their secret may be the inward facilitation of their rush and affiliation; the later event functions as disclosure, moving them from managed concealment into recognized culpability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The earlier rush is embedded in a mouth-heart split and a selective intake rule: profess outwardly, listen through false channels, move words from their places, take a favorable ruling, and beware an unfavorable one. This sharpens the focus rush into tactical option-selection; the spoken fear is part of a public interface while the heart retains another operating rule.

activation_trace.role: The focus utterance supplies the public explanation to be tested against the earlier speech architecture.
The focus concealment supplies the private channel that the mouth-heart split activates.
The same speed branch places the focus haste inside an already described pattern of rapid movement.
Opening the mouth in speech supplies the outward profession that is explicitly detached from the heart.
The heart as understanding supplies the non-assenting interior and links directly to the focus's diseased hearts.
Falsehood supplies the corrupted information stream feeding the tactical rule.
Deviation from direction supplies the operation of moving words away from their settled orientation.
Taking and acquiring supplies the accept-if-favorable half of selective rule shopping.
Alert guarding against a feared result supplies the reject-if-unfavorable half of the same strategy.

structural_cues: 5:41 first names rushing, then contrasts profession by mouths with non-believing hearts.
Its quoted take-or-beware rule makes favorable-outcome selection an explicit behavior before 5:52's spoken risk rationale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated rush, mouth-heart split, distortion, and conditional take-or-beware speech; I infer one tactical architecture continuing into 5:52. A live alternative is that 5:41 and 5:52 describe overlapping but non-identical groups, so the architecture may be analogical rather than continuous.

changed_reading.before: The focus speakers simply state the danger that motivates their speed.
changed_reading.after: Their danger statement can function as the public layer of a selective strategy that seeks favorable channels while an unratified heart commitment remains concealed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The judgment sequence portrays authority already present yet abandoned, forbids people-directed fear and low-price exchange, bars following inclinations, frames plurality as a test, and contrasts uncertain preference with certain judgment. It activates the focus opening as adjudicative closure: a divine ruling exposes whether risk management or authoritative measure governed the hidden choice.

activation_trace.role: Judgment that resolves closure anchors the adjudicative reading in the focus word "opening."
Judgment between people supplies the authoritative measure that the actors solicit and then evade.
Presence with them supplies the paradox that access to authority does not ensure submission to it.
Turning away supplies the evasive response after an authoritative measure is available.
Fear with awe explicitly contrasts fear of people with fear of God and recalibrates the focus's stated fear.
Exchange supplies the transactional mechanism by which principle can be traded for perceived security.
Price in exchange supplies the low valuation assigned to authoritative signs under social pressure.
Following in sequence supplies the prohibited act of letting another guide displace the given measure.
Inclination of the self supplies the internal preference that competes with adjudication.
A test that makes condition visible supplies the diagnostic purpose of differing circumstances.
The repeated judgment branch makes the contrast between sought and divine judgment explicit.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the epistemic posture opposite fear-driven option shopping.

structural_cues: 5:43 juxtaposes a ruling already with them, seeking another arbitration, and turning away.
5:44-50 repeatedly returns to judging by what God sent, redirects fear, prohibits inclination-following, and closes with certainty.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated judgment frame, fear contrast, exchange, test, inclination, and certainty; I infer that the focus's فتح can actualize its judgment branch and expose a risk-priced allegiance. Victory or simple relief remains a materially live reading of فتح alongside this adjudicative one.

changed_reading.before: The anticipated opening is an external success that proves the hedge mistaken.
changed_reading.after: The opening can be the authoritative decision that ends rule-shopping, reveals what the speakers priced above the divine measure, and makes their concealed risk calculus regrettable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The packet supplies two accelerated responses to uncertainty. Testing and eventual return direct one speed toward goods, whereas heart-sickness directs the focus speed into a protective group. Speed itself is therefore not the diagnosis; its object, governing fear, and expected destination distinguish faithful competition from opportunistic haste.

activation_trace.role: Speed contrary to slowness anchors the focus's accelerated movement.
A trial that reveals condition supplies uncertainty as a test rather than merely as a threat.
Advancing in a race supplies the packet's positively directed form of speed.
Inclination toward beneficial good supplies the race's object and moral direction.
Return to the origin supplies the common destination before which present movement is evaluated.

structural_cues: 5:48 commands racing toward goods under test and return; 5:52 depicts racing among a group under fear of reversal.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the two speed constructions and their different objects; I infer that they are contrastive orientations of agency. A live alternative is that the verbal forms mark only ordinary urgency and competition without an intended pair.

changed_reading.before: Haste is itself evidence of their sickness.
changed_reading.after: Haste becomes diagnostic only through its vector: they spend urgency on protective belonging instead of racing toward goods under the horizon of return.

context_deltas.mechanism: The adjacent verse reuses the striking-affliction root after turning away and assigns the prospective blow to some of their own wrongs. This folds the focus rationale back on itself: maneuvering to avoid being struck by a turn can participate in the turning-away that makes a divinely intended strike intelligible.

activation_trace.role: A calamity striking a person supplies the feared impact around which the focus hedge is narrated.
The adverse turn supplies the particular feared form of the strike.
Turning away supplies the prior directional act linked to the later affliction.
The same striking-calamity branch relocates impact from an uncontrolled political turn to a consequence God may intend.
Sin supplies the moral source attached to the second striking event.

structural_cues: 5:49 says God may intend to strike them for some sins; 5:52 quotes fear that a turning calamity may strike us.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the close lexical echo and the turning-away/sin frame; I infer an ironic rebound in which avoidance behavior helps produce culpability. The two strikes could instead remain separate warnings with no causal fold between them.

changed_reading.before: Their policy seeks to insure against an external calamity.
changed_reading.after: The insurance policy may invert into exposure: fear of being struck motivates a turn that places their own conduct under another, morally sourced striking.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate frame defines one mutual protection network before the focus and another allegiance network after it, ending in a cohesive party's overcoming. The rush "among them" is thus a bid to cross into a self-supporting solidarity under anticipated reversal; the sequel contests the premise by relocating protection and victory.

activation_trace.role: Rapid movement supplies the attempted entry into a protective relational field.
Love, support, and alliance supply the mutual network immediately antecedent to "among them."
Parts and constituent groups supply the reciprocal "some of them with some" structure of that network.
Supportive allegiance supplies the counter-location of protection after the focus.
Taking supportive allegiance supplies the act that forms the alternative coalition.
A group cohering around one view supplies the resulting organized party.
Overcoming force supplies the outcome that the focus speakers tried to secure through the rival network.

structural_cues: 5:51 defines mutual awliya, 5:52 says they hurry "among them," and 5:55-56 redefine wali and the overcoming party.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the enclosing walaya sequence and the focus pronoun; I infer that the rush is attempted incorporation into a protection network. The exact social and legal scope of walaya remains open and is not settled by this mechanism.

changed_reading.before: They cultivate useful allies in case power changes hands.
changed_reading.after: They race to relocate belonging into a mutually protective network, but the surrounding sequence contests both where protection resides and which coalition actually overcomes.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel places emphatic sworn solidarity beside collapsed deeds and another becoming-state formula. This makes the focus secret socially consequential: public assurances of being "with you" can coexist with a concealed alternative commitment until the opening turns words and works into an observable loss.

activation_trace.role: Concealed inward content anchors the gap between solidarity claims and operative commitment.
An oath apportioned to its parties supplies the formal public assurance of solidarity.
The sworn oath supplies the assurance's emphatic binding form.
Falling and decline supply the collapse of the position built through those assurances.
Purposive deeds supply what is nullified, extending exposure beyond speech to enacted strategy.
Becoming a new state repeats the focus transition from concealed posture to public result.
Commercial loss supplies the failed return on their strategic investment.

structural_cues: 5:53 immediately asks about those who swore maximal oaths that they were with you, then says their deeds collapsed and they became losers.
The focus and 5:53 both use becoming to mark a settled post-disclosure state.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the immediate oath, collapse, and becoming-loss sequence; I infer that the focus secret concerns divided solidarity expressed through conduct. A live alternative is that 5:53 reports believers' discovery without specifying the full content of what 5:52 says was concealed.

changed_reading.before: The concealed matter is an unspecified private thought that later causes remorse.
changed_reading.after: The concealed matter can be a divided commitment hidden beneath maximal solidarity claims, with the opening exposing both the claim and the works built around it as loss.

context_deltas.mechanism: The next movement answers defection with God bringing another people whose fear structure is opposite: they act without fearing blame and receive divine bounty. The focus's "God may bring" can therefore include social replacement as the form taken by opening or matter, not only an impersonal event.

activation_trace.role: Coming and arrival anchor the focus intervention in a verb repeated by the replacement sequence.
Apostasy and turning back supply the vacancy to which the incoming people respond.
The coming branch supplies the exact divine-arrival echo that introduces replacement, alongside the root's later giving occurrence.
A people or human collective supplies the social embodiment of what God brings.
Expected-harm fear, explicitly negated here, supplies the contrast to the focus speakers' governing anticipation.
Blame for what merits reproach supplies the social pressure that the incoming people do not fear.
Divine gift and beneficence supply the positive resource replacing fear-based insurance.

structural_cues: 5:52 says God may bring the opening or a matter; 5:54 says God will bring a people after defection.
The focus speakers fear a reversal, while the incoming people do not fear a blamer's blame.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the repeated divine-coming syntax, defection, incoming people, and reversed fear posture; I infer that replacement can instantiate the anticipated opening. A live alternative is that 5:54 describes a later analogous response rather than the same event anticipated in 5:52.

changed_reading.before: The opening is an event that changes the balance around the existing actors.
changed_reading.after: The opening may operate by changing the actors themselves: fearful defectors are exposed while a differently oriented people arrive and occupy the vacated role.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries bodily branches of sickness and circular dizziness into political judgment. It remains anchored in the focus's seeing, sickness, circle, and opening, and it explains haste as disoriented stabilization. Downstream prose should present it only as a somatic analogy, not replace the ordinary adverse-turn sense of دائرة.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ترى ... في قلوبهم مرض ... دائرة ... الفتح

activation_trace.role: Visual and insightful perception supplies the diagnostic viewpoint from which disorientation can be recognized.
Dimming and loss of clarity supplies an impaired perceptual field within the heart.
Dizziness of the head supplies the felt instability that can provoke a rush for immediate support.
Unclosing by insight or relief supplies restoration of legibility after the vertiginous hedge.

changed_reading.before: They rationally scan a rotating field and move toward the safest side.
changed_reading.after: Their inner loss of clarity makes the field feel vertiginous; the rush is an attempt to stop that dizziness, while the opening restores enough clarity to see the move as regrettable.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the disputed antithetical branch in which أسر can denote making manifest. The exact focus form, opening, seeing, and later becoming keep the activation anchored, but downstream prose should call it lexical irony or branch resonance, never a forced replacement translation of "concealed."
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sequence from ترى through الفتح to ما أسروا and فيصبحوا.

activation_trace.role: The contested manifestation sense inside the concealment root supplies the secret's latent tendency to become public.
Causing something to be seen supplies the verse's diagnostic exposure vector.
Unclosing and disclosure by insight supplies the event that releases the secret's manifest side.
Becoming a settled condition supplies the conversion from hidden content to observable consequence.

changed_reading.before: A wholly hidden motive remains private until an external victory happens.
changed_reading.after: The hidden motive carries an ironic manifest edge: the opening does not invent its exposure but completes a movement already latent in the verse's conceal/show tension.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a branch-distant material analogy: the harmful-swelling image of حبط is mapped onto emphatic oath display. It remains validly anchored by the focus's concealed interior and the immediate oath-collapse-becoming sequence. Downstream prose should qualify it as an image of inflated exteriority, not as the lexical meaning of the 5:53 verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ما أسروا في أنفسهم followed immediately by maximal oaths, collapsed works, and another becoming-state.

activation_trace.role: A hidden interior supplies what the emphatic exterior fails to represent.
A formal oath supplies the public shell of asserted solidarity.
Sworn force supplies the shell's emphatic inflation.
Swelling from harmful intake supplies the cross-domain image of an enlarged exterior with a damaging interior.
Becoming a new state supplies the shell's collapse into publicly settled loss.

changed_reading.before: Their assurances are simply falsified when events change.
changed_reading.after: Their maximal assurances can be pictured as an inflated shell around a damaging concealed commitment; disclosure collapses the enlargement and leaves the actual loss visible.

strongest_changes: The 5:30-31 self-facilitation, covering, and exact becoming-regret recurrence turns the focus secret from passive thought into a possible action-producing interior.
The 5:41 mouth-heart and take-or-beware sequence makes the spoken fear part of tactical option-selection rather than a complete account of motive.
The 5:43-50 judgment sequence activates فتح as adjudicative closure that exposes a fear-priced allegiance.
The 5:51-56 walaya frame makes the rush a bid for protective incorporation, while the repeated divine-coming syntax opens a replacement reading.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly changes the same focus mechanisms rather than merely adding topics: two kinds of speed, two striking afflictions, two becoming-state endpoints, rival protection networks, and a divine-coming echo all converge on how concealed risk management becomes exposed.
remaining_uncertainties: فتح can retain victory, relief, and opening senses alongside adjudicative closure; the trace does not choose one.
The exact content of what was concealed is not stated, so divided allegiance remains an abductive reconstruction.
The people brought in 5:54 may instantiate the event anticipated in 5:52 or may be a later analogous replacement.
The somatic, antithetical-secret, and oath-inflation readings require explicit exploratory qualification.
